samples: But...it's a little too small for you, Link...
Hmm...you can't get around the large rock or through the small hole as you are now, Link. I wonder what we can do to get past here...
This hole is too small for you to fit through, Link...
Maybe you can force yourself through? No...let's not do that.
What is this? Those are some funky goggles. Maybe if you wear them, other things will look funky too.
Maybe the eyes of truth that Sheik was talking about are these weird goggles. I've got a feeling that if you wear them, things in the world will look weird too.
I hope you're ready. Remember, don't feel bad when you're choking on my dust!
That's not how it's supposed to go!
You brat! Race me again!
If you lose this time, you'll still pay up in rupees, but if you win...
Why isn't this guy getting thrown?! He must have some kind of supernatural luck...
How?! How could this happen?!
I think Epona likes you, fairy child! Hee hee! Isn't she sweet? When she gets a bit bigger, I'll let you ride her sometime!
Oh yeah. You know that prize you received for breaking the record? Did you ever find it after I delivered it to your house?
I hope you'll try the course again next time you visit with Epona!
Want to give it another go?
OK. I'll break down the course.
Come back if you change your mind.
I was making my way through the Forest Temple when I was summoned to this place by Rauru the sage.
And then...when you arrived and defeated that creature, I awoke here. And now I'm a sage as well.
I thank you, Hero of Time.
Link...you've grown so much.
I am truly grateful that you helped me out.
Thank you. Both of you.
Hey! Check out this egg!
That thunder was LOUD.
Gotta change the feed...
What's next on the list?
Next I have to do...what?
May as well tidy up here.
I was sleeping so peacefully... What is it?
Just who are you, kid?
That's right. I'm the owner of Lon Lon Ranch. Name's Talon.
I came to the castle to deliver milk, but well, I got sleepy. Next thing ya know, I nodded off.
Eh? Malon's looking for me?
Oh— Oh NO! I left her all on her own!
Ganondorf's gone. He has been banished to the Evil Realm.
At long last, this world will finally see an age of peace.
All of the tragedies that led to this moment... They're my fault.
I was immature. Reckless. Opening up the path to the Sacred Realm...
As a result, so many suffered due to my actions...
And you...losing all of those years...
A creature of darkness, locked away here for some time.
Impa and I received word that a monster had appeared in Kakariko Village, so we came to investigate the area immediately.
I see. This is Ganondorf's doing, isn't it?
So be it. Let us head to the temple, then.
Impa, please be careful.
The water flows, and with it, evil is washed away... You've done well, Link.
Hey, mister! Cool sword!
W-wow! That's a cool sword, mister! Are you a swordsman like me?
Wh-who are you?! He's...he's...huge!
I'm back to training today. Hey, do you wanna hear about some of the monsters I've defeated?
I may be smaller than you, but I'm stronger than I look! That's right! If you've got time, I can tell you all kinds of stuff about the monsters I beat!
You're back? Guess you're interested in hearing about the monsters I bravely defeated, eh?
Hm? A bottle? What's that inside? A message?
Oh! Th-this message—It's from Princess Ruto! There's no doubt about it. It's in her handwriting, blub!
Hm? Let's see, let's see...
WHAT?! Inside... Lord Jabu-Jabu's... BELLY?!
Lord Jabu-Jabu is our people's guardian deity! Surely he would never eat my precious Ruto!
Though...come to think of it, Lord Jabu-Jabu has been behaving strangely in recent days, groaning and growling and whatnot...
Excellent work making it this far, young adventurer. The princess is in the castle just over yonder.
I wonder... What manner of events await you?
Go forth, but be careful! Hoo hoot!
Well now, Link. It seems the time has finally come for your journey to begin.
I am known as Kaepora Gaebora. I am here to offer you both my assistance and my counsel.
The path ahead will be one marked by many trials for you to overcome. Destiny, I believe, has decided that much for you already, lad.
How's the well doing?
Sorry for the trouble.
My beard... The fire...
Things are calmer now...
Nice morning, isn't it?
You're not hurt, are you?
I'm going to go check on the Great Deku Tree. You head on home, OK?
It's not safe—who knows what kind of monsters are lurking around.
What happened to the Great Deku Tree? Is he... Did he...wither away?
No... There's no way. It can't be true...
He IS still alive, right? Right?!
H-hey... You know that's the song that Saria always plays, right?
We can't go on a walk...
See that sleepy old man there? I don't like to gossip, but I think he got fired from his job...
All he does is laze around from morning to night! Seems awfully carefree during such hard times.
That sleepy old man's doing what he does best— nothing, all day long.
Ugh... If only that man would leave already! My dog deserves to have his own bed!
♪Don't you, Richard?♪
You are amazing, Link.
Of course, I'd expect no less from my fiancé. You fought magnificently.
Everything will be as once it was in Zora Domain from now on, thanks to you.
Ah, yes, and lest you've forgotten...
You have my eternal love! I am yours now!
Heh. If only it could be so.
What's with the well?
It's finally calmed down.
Don't think I've seen you around before... First time here in Kakariko Village?
Been hearing rumors about Dampé's ghost until recently. But they seem to have gone quiet. Anyway, just rumors, I suppose.
I hope Dampé's ghost is able to find peace...
There were rumors that people were seeing Dampé's ghost around, but I haven't heard of any new sightings recently.
I'm still selling it!
I'll check my points.
Have you come to sell poes? Or would you like to check your points?
Have you come to sell poes? Or would you like to hear about points?
Welcome, friend! Oh! You have a horse, yes? Hehehe! I can tell by your scent! Well, if that's the case, you should know that I pay extra for big poes!
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Those slacker apprentices have been nothing but trouble since we arrived in Gerudo Valley...
My apprentices are the saddest bunch of slackers I've ever laid eyes on...
I'm counting on you to find my apprentices.
For me, things are just as you see 'em. My work here is finished, so I was thinking of heading to Kakariko Village...
Thanks for getting my apprentices outta trouble. You're OK in my book.
Whoa! You spooked me!
Well now, well now...
Not making deliveries.
I need a fresh batch.
Oh goodness! Our chat has caused my research to completely slip my mind...
Hmm... Seems I've not got much to do. Maybe I'll kill time strolling around the lake...
Did you enjoy your dip in the pool, my boy?
Of course! Oh, and don't forget to bring that girl along with you! You know. The one you're always busy staring at... The cucco girl!
Oh, don't you worry about that! It's no trouble. If you'd like, I can teach you. Surely there's someone you'd like to cook for...
You mean the one about how long ago there was a house standing where the well is now?
Sure, if you believe in that sort of thing... I didn't think you were the type!
Stop by if you're hungry!
Looks a bit run-down...
The Grave-Diggin' Tour!
Where d'ya wanna dig?
Well, that's somethin'.
Perfect night for diggin'.
Wouldja look at that!
Hey, kid! Don't mess with the graves! I'm Dampé, the gravekeeper! My face may be scary, but I'm not a bad guy.... Hm.
Thank you so much, Brother!
I say that on behalf of all Gorons.
I can't believe you defeated Volvagia... You went from tough little pip-squeak to tough big pip-squeak just like that!
I hate to say it, but I'd be a pile of gravel right now if Rauru hadn't pulled me outta the fire back there.
They're calling me the Sage of Fire. So you know I gotta live up to that title.
It all makes me laugh! Am I right, Brother?
That's a lovely melody.
That's a lovely melody.
That's a lovely melody.
That's a lovely melody.
That's a lovely melody.
That's a lovely melody.
That mask looks tough!
I'm not giving it up.
Hmmm. The song you played... It's a little different from Saria's Song.
Hey...that song! You know Saria's Song too?!♪That makes us friends. I've got a little something for ya. Hehe.♪
Hey. You. Don't you think my face is missing something? Like it could be a little more unique. Hmm... What to do about that...
♪What a good song. I never get tired of it, no matter how many times I hear it.♪♪Let's play again sometime, hehe!♪
I never expected someone this handsome would show up to save me... Thank you! Name's Jiro.
Ichiro, the most senior guy on our crew, convinced the four of us carpenters to come here and become Gerudo thieves...
But they are WAY scarier than I thought they'd be! I think we should stick to construction.
I can't wait to get outta this place!
Huh... I heard something!
Ahh... I'll never get out!
Whoa! Someone new? And at a time like this? I gotta keep the business open though! It feels important to stay open, ya know?
Everyone's gone... I gotta keep the business open though. It feels important to stay open, ya know?
No one's here, so no one is buying anything! Except maybe you? Please?
They're back! Everyone's back! Well, technically I never left, so I can't be "back," I guess... Ya know, that's not important.
I'm so glad everyone is back safe and sound.
Thanks for stopping by.
Thanks, pal! That was real nice of you! I'm Saburo.
I'm only here 'cause Jiro, this other carpenter I work with, said it was this big dream to join the Gerudo. Next thing you know, I'm locked up.
Oh well. I've been rescued, so...it all worked out in the end, I guess.
Hee hee! I better get back to the boss. I bet he's worried sick about us...
No! Don't go, don't go!
Hey, you here to help me?'Cause if you wanna help me escape, first you need to steal the key from that, uh, scary guard.
I can't believe you fought for me! ME! I owe you my name, at the very least. I'm Shiro!
I never really wanted to come here, but Saburo insisted we make the journey.
I'm the youngest, newest guy on the crew. It's not like I could disagree. I had no choice...
I bet by now the other guys wish they never came to this place... Next time I see 'em, I won't hold back what I really think!
I need to get outta here!
Of course, you're gonna need to be really sneaky now... There's probably a Gerudo guard around here...somewhere...
Squee... I surrender...
Squee... Ya got me! I'm sorry for attacking you... Let me sell ya the good stuff as an apology.
Squee... I surrender! Let me sell ya the good stuff as an apology.
Squee... I give up! Let me sell ya the good stuff as an apology.
I'll sell ya the good stuff!
Ya got me—I give up! I'll sell ya the good stuff, so let's just move on, 'K?
WOW! You are SO strong! Nice to officially meet you! I'm no criminal, you know. Just a simple carpenter named Ichiro!
One of the newer guys on my crew, Shiro, was going on about the Gerudo and how cool they were, and I got swept up in the thrill of it all.
But as soon as we got here, the Gerudo acted like jerks, treating us like scum just 'cause we're outsiders.
It was so... RUDE! Boy, am I done with this place.
Huh? Is someone there?!
I just wanna go home...
Leavin' ya in the dust.
Got a treasure for ya.
Lookin' for challengers!
I was busy diggin' my own grave when I stumbled upon these ruins. And while I was diggin' every which way, I made a nifty little tunnel system.
Heh heh, then let's get goin'. On your mark, get set...
Heh heh, atta boy. Alrighty, let's go!
One who sees the truth...
Dreadful, dreadful...
I sure appreciate this...
No ghost after all, eh?
Just don't go near the graveyard, eh? You may disturb the ghost of the gravekeeper...
I may be getting on in years, but I'd rather not come face-to-face with the other side just yet!
Spirit of the wild...
There's supposed to be a land of harsh sands beyond the Gerudo Fortress... But how will I get there if they won't let me through?
Prepare your body, friend, and let us enter the wild together!
Haha! It seems you're already doing some other challenge. If you want to take me on, you'll need to finish up that task first!
A-astounding... It's just as I thought! Racing you is the key to exceeding my limits! Here. This is a token of my appreciation!
Men... Monsters... Fish... I've simply become too fast for any of them to compete with me.
You did great, Brother!
I'm heading back to Goron City! I'll wait for the others there!
Big Bro still isn't back...
I can...really go? Thank you! Goro!
Wait... Aren't you...the kid who cleared out the Dodongos back in the day? How'd you wind up here?
Sorry, I'm not much help... But please help Big Brother Darunia and save my friends! Goro!
I'm counting on you...
I can't do this now...
Huh?! That cry...is...
C-Cojiro? Oh, my... Cojiro! Is that really you?!
But you gotta be quick! Take forever, and it'll rot away into nothing!
Wait... You're giving Cojiro back to me? I... I don't know what to say... So you are good after all. In that case, I gotta ask ya...
Thanks so much! If there are others down here, you gotta help them!
Urgh... Can't take much more of this...
I don't do well in cramped spaces... Gotta get outta here...
How're the others? Been worrying about 'em...
What happened? Is it safe?
We'll get this place hopping again to prep for Big Brother's return so he's met with a warm welcome whenever he makes it back!
The name's Biggoronnn.
How ya like that sworrrd?
You made it to Biggoron Blaaades! Welcommme!
How's the edge on that blaaade? Sharp, hmmm?
You can call it the Biggoron Sword, gorrro!
I know you've traveled mighty farrr, but I'm not taking orders right nowww. Sorryyy.
When'll Mido be back?
You sure showed up at a good time!
I wonder if Saria and Mido are doing OK. Hopefully they come back soon and see that the forest is back to normal.
I hope Saria and Mido come home soon. Oh! I better clean up before they get back.
We're all waiting for Saria and Mido to get back. They're taking a while...
What's the deal with that mask? Are you trying to look cute with it or something?
You know, the humans who dare enter the forest have been known to disappear. Actually, they turn into Stalfos.
I knew it! I knew that was made with something from the forest!
Hee hee! I wonder... Would you like that to be your fate?
You can have this in return. I don't need it.
Are you looking for that fellow who was here before? Well, you won't find him here now.
Are you going to give that back?
Hey, kid. Or rather, hello, Link.
I owe you an eternal debt. Thank you.
Ah ha ha ha ha! I can't believe what I'm looking at. The little kid from seven years ago is all grown up—you're a real swordsman now.
Seven whole years, huh?
I can't believe I was so careless. I fell right into their trap.
Those old crones used me like a puppet. They forced me to help Ganondorf get what he was after.
My fins... So cold...
Ah... Sorry! I'm still recovering from being frozen solid. But that doesn't mean we aren't open! Please, feel free to browse.
Please come back ag— Aga—
Pardon me. Please feel free to browse.
Th-thank... Thank... THANK...
Oh, I got carried away, didn't I? Is there anything else you need?
You're not getting away!
OK, let's keep the introductions short. Are you here because you saw the heart-pounding grave-digging too-wuh sign at the entrance?
I know all about this place. I even know all about the graveyard too-wuh.
I'm super busy right now and can't talk! Kids are super busy these days, yanno!
I know all about this place. I even know all about the famous nighttime specialty here.
There's a buncha stuff I wanna tell you all about. But it's dinnertime. I don't want my super-hot soup to get super cold.
Thank you both so much!
I'm the little guy, the baby guy! I'm the... Deku Tree Sprout!
You and Saria managed to free the Forest Temple from the demon's curse...
And right in that moment... I was born!
Thank you so much! There aren't enough thank-yous to thank you enough!
So have you gone back and said hi to the Kokiri yet? Because I bet you they don't even recognize you anymore, do they?
Welcome to Kakariko Village's new attraction: the Shooting Gallery—a place for people who can appreciate a sophisticated game of skill!
I'll give you a bigger quiver!
The promise of a prize pique your interest? Oooh, a new quiver...
I'll give you some arrows, so you won't have to use any of your own.
I've given you 15 arrows to play with, so don't worry about using any of your own.
Uh-oh. That was the last of your arrows.
This is the crest of Hyrule's royal family!
Let's see, let's see...
So then...you're the savior of our kingdom, are you? A true hero...
Ah ha ha ha! Our princess came up with another one of her unusual games, huh?
Trail's closed right now!
Oughta get this home...
It's been a while. Greetings, brave one.
Though...as of late, you're known as the Hero of Time.
You have done well, truly. Slaying that demonic beast from the Shadow Temple? I thank you.
You need not worry. She is safe.
Her Highness will soon make herself known to you, and all will be revealed...
Only then can the sages stop the Demon King and restore peace to Hyrule.
Ah! Hello, Hylian boy! You're interested in a diving lesson? What a splendid idea!
Even with my expert training, there are some skills beyond the grasp of a finless one such as yourself.
But I should be quite able to teach you how to dive as deep as any Zora!
So, my would-be pupil, let's enhance your skills! Are you prepared to dive?
LATER?! I will not spare time teaching the unmotivated! Find your urge to learn, then return to me.
What drive! Truly a fantastic answer! Now then, the task at hand is a simple one...
I buy bottled things!
Sell me bottled things!
Buying bottled things...
Please sell me stuff...
Sorry for bothering you...
Sell me bottled things! Please! I BEG YOU!
The windmill is all wrong now, and there's no one to blame but that ocarina-playing punk!
The well dried up, and it's all because that little punk with the ocarina played a weird song!
Grahhh! I hope I never see another ocarina for the rest of my life! You listen to me, buddy. If you happen to have an ocarina, don't you dare let me see it!
If I so much as catch a whiff of an ocarina, it's all over for you.
H-hey...you... You've got an ocarina?
This song has been stuck in my head ever since!
Welcome to the Potion Shop. If you're looking for Granny's Cauldron, hang a left at the counter and continue on from there.
Even after moving to Kakariko Village, I remain as luminous as ever. I never charge for a chat, you know, so don't be a stranger.
Normally, at Granny's place, you can purchase truly marvelous potions... But not lately. You can't buy anything there at the moment. I wonder what happened.
Granny resumed selling her beloved potions! A little bird told me you procured some ingredients for her. Well done, young man!
Shall we carry on? Oh, of course we shall. It means you get to continue engaging with my radiance.
Cut that out, will you?!
Um, who are you? My big sis told me not to talk to strangers. Sorry.
My big sis told me to not talk to strangers. Sorry.
I'm not allowed to talk to strangers. I'm sorry.
Um, who are you? My big sis told me not to talk to strangers...
You're that grown-up from before. But you're still a stranger, and Big Sis said I should never talk to strangers.
The more I look at him, the more he reminds me of Link. If Link grew up, maybe he'd be a lot like this guy?
This was once Lady Impa's private residence, but these days it's open to visitors. Everyone is welcome inside, including you. So feel free to come and go as you please!
Is this your first time visiting? Well then...allow me to welcome you to Kakariko Village.
Welcome to the lodge, home of to-die-for views of Death Mountain. How can I help you today?
Talk to you later, then.
Welcome to the lodge, home of to-die-for views of Death Mountain. You're out late, aren't you?
Hm? Oh, you're wondering why I'm standing out here if everyone's welcome inside? Well... I mean, take a look for yourself.
I saw you wandering around... Who are you, mister? We're trying to figure out how to help Saria, so try to keep it down.
We wanna find Saria, but there are so many monsters, and we don't even have a map!
Saria hasn't returned from the Forest Temple, but we can't go after her with all those monsters out there.
Saria... I hope she's OK.
I wonder if Saria's stuck for the same reason. Too many monsters...
Kokiri Forest is finally free of monsters. Now I only wonder when Saria will be back. I hope it's soon.
Mido still hasn't come back. I wonder if he's in the Lost Woods. If he doesn't come back soon, I'll be stuck watching his house forever...
Mido still hasn't come back. I know he's gone to the Lost Woods, but I wonder what for... Maybe he's out there blocking someone's way, just like he used to do...
Eh? You've got a fairy, so maybe you're one of us... You ARE one of us...right?
You must be one of us, so I've gotta ask: Did you see Mido on the way here? He went off to the Lost Woods and hasn't come back since.
I've been keeping an eye on Mido's house for forever. I wonder how long I should stay here...
I've been watching Mido's house forever. He hasn't come home even once...
Try out some archery.
Almost time to open...
Seems your horse is ready and raring to go too! You'll break some records for sure!
Your horse seems ready, and you've got your game face on! I bet you'll really nail it!
Oh wow, your friend's coat is looking luscious and glossy! Clear proof that you treasure her. That must be why the two of you got such a high score. Now, then...
I can't remember the last time I felt this excited.
I'm telling you, I saw it...
Are you listening to me?
I'm telling you! I know what I saw! It was an old man's ghost disappearing into a glowing grave in the graveyard!
Does it matter what I believe? I KNOW what I saw in the graveyard...and it was an old man's ghost!
No way am I going back there! I don't want to relive that terror!
Listen... I'm telling the truth... I actually saw the ghost of an old man in the graveyard! I really, truly saw it! You have to believe me!
I feel the curse lifting!
Thank you! Thank you!
Ah, it is my honor and a pleasure to speak with you.
My entire family has been transformed by this terrible curse. It is why I'm trapped in this frightful body.
This curse has trapped us in these forms for years on end...
Perhaps you're willing to help us? Perhaps you'll be the one to collect all the tokens from Gold Skulltulas and save us?
This way, this way...
Over here, over here...
The way to the Spirit Temple lies ahead, winding a narrow path through the harsh sands.
You won't make it without a guide. But don't you worry—I'll show ya the way.
Seems ya got yourself some eyes of truth...
You won't make it without a guide. But don't you worry—I'll show ya the way. Just don't fall behind, got it?
Eek— Wait, it's him again.
Huh?! Y-you have a fairy! Does that mean you're one of us?
There are monsters everywhere out there, but... somehow you're fine?
Where's Saria, and why did she leave her house like this? Could she be lost in the Lost Woods?
Oh no! Maybe Saria can't come home because she's surrounded by monsters... Please, mister! If you find Saria in the Lost Woods, you have to help her!
Have you seen the Great Deku Tree's child yet? According to my fairy, he's a cute little thing. All nice and round! Maybe later I'll go see him for myself.
So... You're searching for the temple, are you?
Don't worry... You can keep that blade in its sheath, Hylian. Consider yourself safe...for now.
Then...perhaps you and I can strike a deal. It's simple, really. You grant my request—I give you something in return... What do you say?
You're actually interested? That's good to hear... We Gerudo know the place you seek well. We call it the Spirit Temple.
Do we have a deal, Hylian?
Really? But without us, you'll never make it to the desert, let alone the temple.
Don't eat me, goro! I can get you something tastier! Like rock roast! As much as you want!
What...just happened?!
Hey, do you know when Big Bro Darunia's gonna be back? Please don't tell me he got lost in the Fire Temple...
Wh-who are you? Could you be some kinda monster...sent by Ganondorf?!
Wh-who are you? Could you be some kinda bone monster...sent by Ganondorf?!
Wh-who are you? Could you be some kinda wooden monster...sent by Ganondorf?!
Welcome iiin! We've got plenty to choose from!
No matter what's happening out in the world, it's always business as usual here.
We sell shields but not swords.
Deku sticks and Deku seeds are for kids. I'll sell them to you, but adults can't use them.
You're a chatty adult, aren't you? Hope you don't mind if I start to repeat myself.
There aren't many items here for grown-ups... Uh, sorry about that.
Welcome to the Kakariko Village Bazaar!
I don't think I've got anything new to talk about, but I can tell you what I already told you. Again!
After we moved our shop here, things really went downhill in Castle Town. It's probably best to stay away from that place now...
Things in Kakariko Village have gotten scary at times, but we get by.
You've noticed the dark clouds surrounding Death Mountain, yeah? I don't like 'em. The Gorons live up there, you know. Hopefully those guys are doing OK.
I got seriously worried when all those fires broke out... Just the thought of my shop burning down and needing to move again had me sweating. And not from the fire!
You have a fairy, so does that mean you're a Kokiri too?
What are you, mister? Please don't tell me you're some kinda monster.
Are you a monster?! No, I think you're... a grown-up?!
I can see now that you have a fairy. Does that mean you're a Kokiri?
But Kokiri don't grow up... What's going on here?
For some reason the monsters that were here just...disappeared. I don't know what happened, but I'm not complaining!
I don't know you, sir. But...you've got a fairy. Does that mean you're one of us? We're hanging in there... Maybe you can go help the others?
Everything's OK here! I'll guard against monster attacks with my trusty Deku Shield!
Don't worry about us. I'll protect my sister with this Deku Shield!
If you meet a boy out there with a Deku Shield named Link, can you tell him something for me? Please tell him we're all waiting for him to come back!
His name is Link. It's been a long time since he left, so you probably wouldn't know him...
With the monsters all gone, this forest is peaceful again. Now I've got to tidy up for whenever Link comes back, tee hee!
No way! There is no way you actually saw what you think you saw!
Do you seriously believe in ghosts?
If that's what you saw, let's go to the graveyard and see if it's still there! Just lead the way!
Alright, then you'll go to the graveyard with me? I'm ready whenever you are!
Alright, then let's head to the graveyard already!
There's no such thing as ghosts!
Maybe... There's already plenty of Hylians in Kakariko Village, so that might be the safest bet. Then again, it might be fun living in Goron City!
I gave it a try once, but no... I don't think so. Looks like Kakariko is our only choice.
This is tempting too...
It's not an easy choice...
Which do people prefer?
I can never decide...
Nothing unusual here.
Please, try to stay calm.
Hmm? I haven't seen you around.
Hey, it's the out-of-towner!
Do you need something?
Do you need something?
You are here and now again!
I am a seller of rare and not-usual items! Everyone can be my customer!
Very unfortunate that you are not buying. I wish you goodbye!
Ooh, you are lacking in the rupees! And I am lacking in wanting to sell for less...
Oh no, you are lacking in the space to hold any more. Return when this is different!
Oooh! If you do the buying now, you won't be able to hold all you buy. Is this still your wish?
What is to be done...
I'm sorry about Ruto...
O-oh! Forgive my rudeness. I had not expected that the messenger would be a mere child.
